cue-margin-trading 1.0.0

- Initial release: enables deep research of margin trading (融资融券) scenarios using Cue.
- Supports dynamic selection of research modules (“搭子”), including competitor intelligence, ETF/tech policy comparison, and risk contraction alerts.
- Integrated with cue-research runner; flexible setup via manual or one-step clone/update.
- Results include cross-source public data and sources, ensuring transparency.
- Usage requires confirmation of credit consumption before initiating research runs.
